decision: Use all 19 stars and both green parities, independently per calibration and direction of the 7+7 exposure split. Select a zone angle only from the other stars in the same zone using aggregate training-half minimum loss over nuisance shape parameters. Then choose the target width, wings and axis ratio at that angle on the training half. Compare regional and own-star angle against circular reference on the untouched held-out half. The parent model bank, supports, nuisance fitting and centers are frozen. No target-dependent angle or validation-half selection for the regional model.
